column1: # The guard and policy denials a configuration knob governs. A denial
# mission control notes (scripts/mc-decide.sh note --shape denial) whose
# guard and text a row matches counts toward a repeat of that row's knob,
# and scripts/mc-proposals.sh proposes the knob to the operator, handed
# over ready to apply and never written. A row matches when the guard is
# the noted subject's key and the match ERE matches the denial's text; the
# first matching row wins, and a guard names a knob in one row only, since a
# proposal finds its value by guard and knob. layer is the overlay layer the
# value belongs in (adopter, repo-tracked or machine-local, docs/overlays.md),
# one the guard reads that knob from; effect says what the value changes, in
# plain words, as the confirmation shows it.

column6: a pull request behind its base branch can be marked ready once GitHub reports it mergeable and its checks passed on its head with at least one success; a conflicting, unconfirmed or red one is still refused
